title: Google Maps Message Button Now Sits Next to Call: What Home Service Businesses Should Do
html:
The Google Maps message button now appears next to Call on Android and iOS once chat is enabled, per Google's November 5, 2026 bulletin. Home service businesses should set a fast reply routine and gather appeal documents now. A visible inbox and a one-shot appeal both punish slow preparation.

Source: Google Business Profile Community: Google Small Business Bulletin, Holiday Checklist and New Features, published November 5, 2026.

What did Google change on Maps and Business Profiles in November 2026?

Google now puts a Message button next to the Call button on Maps profiles with chat switched on, on both Android and iOS. According to Search Engine Roundtable, chat used to sit far down a profile. Search Engine Roundtable adds that people can now tap into it from the expanded profile header or the bottom action bar.

Customers who tap it reach the WhatsApp or text channel the business picked, per the same report. The second change is a reworked appeals tool. Relevant Audience says the revamped tool names the broken policy first, takes supporting files and gives each appeal a single submission.

Which home service profiles will show the message button?

Only profiles that have chat set up. Google's chat help page says WhatsApp and text options go to claimed, verified profiles in select regions only.

Relevant Audience adds that Google has not named the countries covered.

Text chat requires a phone number able to take text messages. Adding both leaves customers with just the text option.

Mistake to avoid: typing the office landline into the chat field. A number that cannot receive texts may leave customers with a button that goes nowhere.

Why does the message button raise the stakes on response time?

A visible button gives a homeowner a second way to reach you. An unanswered message is easy to read as a lack of interest. Relevant Audience made a similar point, warning that a dead link or an unread inbox now sits in a very visible place.

What reply routine should a home service business set up?

Message typeExampleFirst replyWho answers
EmergencyNo heat, burst pipe, roof leakWithin minutes, then a phone callDispatcher or on-call tech
Quote requestKitchen remodel, new fenceSame business day, with two screening questionsEstimator or office lead
Schedule changeExisting customer moving a visitSame dayOffice staff
After hoursMessage sent at nightAuto-reply or first-thing reply with an exact timeNext shift opener

Write three saved replies in advance: an emergency reply, a quote reply and an after-hours reply. Then send yourself a test message each week to confirm it arrives where you expect.

Roofers and HVAC shops with missed after-hours calls can look at an AI receptionist for roofers as a way to cover nights. Remodelers, who handle fewer but larger jobs, can lean on photos and a short questionnaire in the first reply.

Mistake to avoid: sending chat to an office number that nobody checks after 5 pm. The button stays visible all night, even when your team is not there.

What changed in the Business Profile appeals flow?

The appeals tool now puts the reason up front. Relevant Audience reports that it shows the violated policy. Google's appeals help page adds the decision date, appeal eligibility and current status.

Google's help page describes four steps: pick the decision, optionally upload files with an explanation, tick a readiness box and submit. It also says each appeal can be submitted only once.

The help page gives no review timeframe. It says Google emails the decision and that the appeals tool shows the status.

How should a home service business prepare for a suspension?

Build the evidence folder before you need it, because you only get one submission. Google's appeals page suggests a business license, registration papers, tax certificates and utility bills as helpful proof.

It adds that each document should show the same business name and address as the profile and your registration. The table below turns that into a check for a trade business.

DocumentWhat to compare with the profileCommon trade gap
Contractor or trade licenseBusiness name and license holderProfile uses a short brand name, license uses the full legal name
Business registrationLegal name and addressProfile shows an old address
Utility billName and service addressBill is in the owner's name, not the business
Tax certificateLegal nameName spelled differently from the profile

Google's page says a suspended profile disappears from public view and cannot be managed by owners or managers. A landscaper in peak season loses calls the day it happens, so a ready folder shortens the gap.

Mistake to avoid: sending the one appeal while the legal name and the profile name still differ. Fix the mismatch in the profile first when you can, then appeal.

Is Google putting Book Online links on profiles without owners asking?

It may be, but the report gives no sign that Google has commented. Search Engine Roundtable reported on November 9, 2026, that local SEO practitioners saw Book Online links on profiles with no booking software set up.

The same report says some of the links open a Google error page. The report says owners can manage those links from their profile as it appears in Search.

Owners who run Local Services Ads should check that booking links and ad calls land in one intake. That way no lead is handled twice.

What should you ignore or wait on for now?

Ignore the rest of the bulletin unless it fits your business. Relevant Audience also lists Gemini tools, plain-language hours and restaurant delivery controls. It flags that Google's help page continues to leave out work accounts from the Gemini tools.

Wait for Google's help pages to name the countries and any reply rules before you change staffing around them.

Where does the Google Maps message button appear?

Google's November 2026 bulletin says it shows up beside Call on Maps, on Android and iOS, when a profile has chat turned on. Customers can also start a chat from the profile's top header or bottom action bar. Without chat set up, the button does not appear.

Are booking links showing up on profiles without any setup?

It may be, but the report gives no sign that Google has commented. Search Engine Roundtable reported on November 9, 2026, that some profiles show Book Online links without booking software. Some of the links open a Google error page. Search your business name, click every button and fix broken links.

Sources

  • Google Business Profile Community: Google Small Business Bulletin, Holiday Checklist and New Features, November 5, 2026 (original report; date as given by Relevant Audience)
  • Search Engine Roundtable: Google Expands Business Messaging To Google Maps On iOS and Android, November 6, 2026
  • Relevant Audience: Google Maps puts Message next to Call: November Small Business Bulletin, November 7, 2026
  • Search Engine Roundtable: Google Adding Booking Links To Business Profiles Automatically?, November 9, 2026
  • Google Business Profile Help: Business Profile appeals help page, undated
  • Google Business Profile Help: Business Profile chat help page, undated
